refresh_policy: Re-run monthly by .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml. A pull request is opened only when content_fingerprint changes; a run that finds nothing new leaves the committed data untouched, so fetched_at reflects when these bytes were retrieved rather than when they were last checked.

country_metadata.title: mledoze/countries
country_metadata.notes: Replaces REST Countries v3.1, which was deprecated in favour of a key-gated v5 (see DATA_DECISIONS.md #1). This is the dataset REST Countries is built from. Used only for country metadata (names, ISO codes, borders, capital, area, currencies, languages). Never used for population or economic figures -- its population field is undated and disagrees with UN WPP. One documented upstream correction is applied (Vatican City UN membership).

un_wpp.title: UN World Population Prospects 2024
un_wpp.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024, Online Edition. Medium variant.
un_wpp.notes: Counts converted from the published thousands to persons. Estimates run through 2023; later years are the medium-variant projection, with low/high variants supplied as bands. Bulk CSV rather than the Data Portal API, which requires a token (see DATA_DECISIONS.md).

world_bank.title: World Bank World Development Indicators
world_bank.vintage: per indicator and country; newest observation 2025
world_bank.notes: 41 indicators. Every value carries its own observation year -- there is no single current year across indicators. Regional and income aggregates are excluded via the API's region.id == 'NA' flag.

owid_indicators.title: Our World in Data — curated indicators
owid_indicators.vintage: per indicator and country; newest observation 2026
owid_indicators.citation: Global Carbon Budget (2025); Population based on various sources (2024); Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research (2026); Institute for Crime & Justice Policy Research (2026); Population based on various sources (2024); Jonathan Hanson and Rachel Sigman (2021); Population based on various sources (2023); V-Dem (2026), via Our World in Data
owid_indicators.notes: 10 series, primary source for the Freedom section (V-Dem democracy and human-rights indices, Regimes of the World classification) and CO2 per capita (Global Carbon Budget). Distinct from the population cross-check, which remains validation-only.

rsf_press_freedom.title: RSF World Press Freedom Index
rsf_press_freedom.licence: © Reporters Without Borders; reproduced with attribution
rsf_press_freedom.citation: Reporters Without Borders (RSF), World Press Freedom Index 2026
rsf_press_freedom.notes: 178 countries matched to the registry. First-party CSV; the OWID mirror was rejected (frozen in 2021 on the old inverted 0-is-best methodology).

unodc_prisons.title: UNODC — persons held in prisons and penal facilities
unodc_prisons.licence: United Nations / UNODC terms; free reuse with attribution
unodc_prisons.citation: UNODC, Data Portal — Prisons and prisoners (CTS)
unodc_prisons.notes: 226 countries with prisoner totals, 93 with facility counts. The xlsx href is re-discovered from the landing page each run because its path is release-dated.

wikipedia_capital_punishment.title: Capital punishment by country (Wikipedia)
wikipedia_capital_punishment.citation: Wikipedia, 'Capital punishment by country' (execution figures originally compiled by Amnesty International)
wikipedia_capital_punishment.notes: 194 countries matched. Amnesty publishes only PDFs and no keyless structured source exists; Wikipedia's tables are the machine-readable secondary source, used with per-page attribution.

education_extras.title: University and library counts; CWUR rankings
education_extras.licence: Hipolabs MIT; Wikidata CC0; CWUR © Center for World University Rankings, displayed with attribution
education_extras.citation: Hipolabs university-domains-list; Wikidata; Center for World University Rankings (CWUR) 2026
education_extras.notes: 200 countries with university counts, 114 with Wikidata library counts, 93 with CWUR-ranked institutions.

imf_weo.title: IMF World Economic Outlook (DataMapper API)
imf_weo.citation: IMF World Economic Outlook, via the DataMapper API
imf_weo.notes: 192 entities with debt (% of GDP), 195 with nominal GDP. Not CORS-enabled, so build-time only.

currency_images.title: Currency images (Wikidata P18 via Wikimedia Commons)
currency_images.licence: Per-file Commons licences, recorded per image
currency_images.citation: Wikidata; Wikimedia Commons (per-file attribution in artifact)
currency_images.notes: 131 currencies with a usable image; 0 Wikidata-referenced files missing on Commons were dropped. Hotlinked at width 960 via Special:FilePath.

wikidata_subdivisions.title: Wikidata — first-level administrative divisions
wikidata_subdivisions.vintage: as retrieved; division populations carry their own vintages
wikidata_subdivisions.notes: 215 countries, 4117 divisions, 3657 with a population figure. Former administrative entities excluded by P31 filter.

climate.title: Copernicus ERA5 country temperatures (via OWID); GeoNames capitals
climate.licence: Copernicus/OWID CC BY 4.0; GeoNames CC BY 4.0
climate.citation: Contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information (2026); GeoNames
climate.notes: 193 entities with temperature series, 241 capitals. Live weather itself is fetched by the BROWSER from Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0, non-commercial API) and never enters /data.

wikidata_inventions.title: Inventions: Wikidata origin tags + Wikipedia list articles
wikidata_inventions.licence: Wikidata CC0; Wikipedia CC BY-SA 4.0; per-file Commons licences on images
wikidata_inventions.citation: Wikidata (P495/P61/P575); English Wikipedia per-country invention lists; Wikimedia Commons
wikidata_inventions.notes: 53 countries with qualifying items, 363 inventions (195 Wikidata food/drink items excluded by class, 26 Wikipedia list entries excluded by description). Wikidata origin tags plus 50 curated Wikipedia list articles.

airports.title: OurAirports roster; Wikidata annual passengers
airports.vintage: roster as retrieved; passenger figures carry their own years
airports.notes: 234 countries, 1642 airports listed, 1210 with a passenger figure. Traffic ranking is best-available, not exhaustive.

wikipedia_national_symbols.title: Wikipedia — lists of national animals, trees and flowers
wikipedia_national_symbols.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text); images CC0/CC-BY via iNaturalist or per-file Commons licences
wikipedia_national_symbols.citation: Wikipedia: List of national animals; List of national trees; List of national flowers. Photos: iNaturalist (CC0/CC-BY, research grade) with Wikimedia Commons fallback
wikipedia_national_symbols.notes: 142 countries with at least one symbol; 357 symbol images with Commons attribution. Unmatched rows: Central America and the Caribbean, Macedonia.

wikidata_cuisine.title: Cuisine: TheMealDB (primary) + Wikidata dishes (fallback)
wikidata_cuisine.licence: TheMealDB free/educational tier, attributed; Wikidata CC0; per-file Commons licences on fallback images
wikidata_cuisine.citation: TheMealDB (themealdb.com); Wikidata (P495 on dish items); Wikimedia Commons
wikidata_cuisine.notes: 116 countries, 576 dishes; 62 countries served by TheMealDB's uniform 700x700 photography, the rest by Wikidata+Commons. Countries covered by neither render as unavailable.

natural_earth.title: Natural Earth 110m Admin 0 (via world-atlas TopoJSON)
natural_earth.notes: Re-keyed from UN M49 to ISO3. Kosovo, Northern Cyprus and Somaliland carry no M49 code and are assigned explicitly (Kosovo to XKX; the other two to Cyprus and Somalia, matching how UN WPP and the World Bank report that territory, though each keeps its own name on the map and is hatched as contested). 63 populated entities are too small to appear at 110m and are emitted as point markers instead.

flagcdn.title: flagcdn.com flag SVGs
flagcdn.notes: Flag SVGs rasterised and quantised to a dominant non-neutral colour for 250 entities. Map fills take the flag hue at one of four graph-coloured lightness tiers so no two bordering countries share a fill.

cia_factbook.title: CIA World Factbook (factbook.json mirror)
cia_factbook.vintage: per field; each composition figure carries its own census or estimate year
cia_factbook.citation: Central Intelligence Agency, The World Factbook
cia_factbook.notes: Joined to ISO3 by country name read from each file, not by GEC code. 242 entities matched. Composition percentages are passed through exactly as published -- never rescaled to 100, never interpolated, never projected. Fields with no published percentage are marked non-chartable and render as prose.

wikidata_leaders.title: Wikidata heads of state and government, portraits via Wikimedia Commons
wikidata_leaders.licence: Wikidata: CC0. Portraits: individual Commons licences, attributed via the linked file page.
wikidata_leaders.notes: 233 entities, 421 portraits. Collective offices without a single incumbent ship no portrait: AND:hos(2), BEN:hog(3), BIH:hos(3), CUW:hog(2), DJI:hog(2), GNB:hos(3), KGZ:hog(9), MAC:hog(4), SMR:hos(2), SXM:hos(2), TCD:hog(2), WSM:hog(2).

unesco_whc.title: UNESCO World Heritage List
unesco_whc.licence: © UNESCO World Heritage Centre; syndication feed
unesco_whc.citation: UNESCO World Heritage Centre, World Heritage List
unesco_whc.notes: 1272 inscribed properties across 173 entities. Transboundary sites listed under every member state.

resolve_ecoregions.title: RESOLVE Ecoregions 2017
resolve_ecoregions.citation: Dinerstein et al. (2017), An Ecoregion-Based Approach to Protecting Half the Terrestrial Realm, BioScience 67(6)
resolve_ecoregions.notes: Intersected with Natural Earth 50m country polygons in EPSG:6933. Ecoregion geometry simplified at 1000 m in projected metres before the overlay. Shares are percentages of each entity's own land area.

owid.title: Our World in Data — Population
owid.citation: HYDE (2023); Gapminder (2022); UN WPP (2024), via Our World in Data
owid.notes: Cross-check only, never a primary source. Its modern series is UN WPP 2024, so this validates our parsing rather than the underlying estimates.

entities.json.description: Canonical entity registry. The ISO3 join key for every other artifact, including editorial rulings on contested entities and continent assignment.

population/series/<ISO3>.json.description: Full 1950-2100 demographic series per entity, medium variant with low/high projection bands.

population/timeline.json.description: Population by year for every entity, continent and the world, in thousands. Feeds the time scrubber; lazy-loaded.

population/pyramids/<ISO3>.json.description: Age x sex population by five-year age group, every 5th year.

indicators/gdp-summary.json.description: Latest GDP (current US$) per entity, for the entity table.

indicators/catalogue.json.description: Indicator metadata, units, sections, and entity coverage.

indicators/by-country/<ISO3>.json.description: Full World Bank indicator series per entity, each value carrying its own observation year.

owid/catalogue.json.description: OWID indicator metadata, citations, and coverage.

owid/by-country/<ISO3>.json.description: Our World in Data indicator series per entity (V-Dem democracy and rights indices, regime classification, CO2 per capita), each value carrying its own observation year.

freedom/press-freedom.json.description: RSF press-freedom score and rank per entity.

crime/unodc-prisons.json.description: Total persons held in prison and number of penal facilities per entity, latest reported year.

crime/death-penalty.json.description: Death penalty legal status, last execution year, and latest Amnesty execution figure per entity.

education/education.json.description: University count, Wikidata public-library count, and CWUR top-10 universities per entity.

economy/debt.json.description: General government gross debt (% of GDP) and nominal GDP annual series per entity, IMF WEO, including projections.

economy/currency-images.json.description: Representative currency image per ISO 4217 code, with Commons file page, licence and author for attribution.

subdivisions/<ISO3>.json.description: First-level administrative divisions (states, provinces, cantons...) with latest Wikidata populations, sorted by population.

climate/climate.json.description: Annual mean surface temperature (latest year) and 50-year decade-mean warming per entity.

climate/capitals.json.description: Capital coordinates for the live weather panel.

inventions/<ISO3>.json.description: Notable inventions (name, inventor, approximate year, Commons image with attribution) for countries with Wikidata coverage.

airports/<ISO3>.json.description: Top airports per entity (name, IATA, city, annual passengers where recorded), large first.

flora-fauna/<ISO3>.json.description: National animal(s), tree and flower with Commons images and attribution, per entity.

cuisine/<ISO3>.json.description: Signature dishes with Commons images and attribution, per entity.

geo/countries-110m.json.description: Country polygons keyed by ISO3, for map rendering.

geo/markers.json.description: Point markers for populated entities with no polygon at 110m.

flags/map-palette.json.description: Normalised map fills, continent accents, and per-entity flag accent colours with AA-safe text steps.

flags/svg/.description: The flag SVGs themselves, one per entity keyed by ISO3, shown on country detail pages. Committed because the app never calls an upstream at render time.

factbook/<ISO3>.json.description: Qualitative country facts: government, people composition, industries and trade, each field with its own vintage.

leaders/leaders.json.description: Heads of state and government with portrait paths and Commons attribution links.

heritage/sites.json.description: World Heritage properties per entity: name, category, inscription year, in-danger and transboundary flags.

biomes/biomes.json.description: Biome and ecoregion shares by entity and by continent.

warnings: crosswalk: border asymmetry in country metadata (LKA->IND not mirrored); resolved by union so the adjacency colouring stays safe.

UN WPP 2024 publishes no population series for 13 registry entities (ALA, ATA, ATF, BVT, CCK, CXR, HMD, IOT, NFK, PCN, SGS, SJM, UMI); these render as unavailable rather than zero. Most are uninhabited territories, but Aland Islands and Svalbard are inhabited and are reported within Finland and Norway respectively.
RSF index carried 2 ISO3 codes absent from the registry: CSS, CTU.
Capital punishment table rows not matched to the registry: Congo, Democratic Republic of the, Congo, Republic of the, Myanmar Burma.
CWUR locations not matched to the registry: Northern Cyprus, Turkey.

63 populated entities are too small to render as polygons at 110m resolution and appear as point markers instead, among them Singapore, Malta, Hong Kong and Macao. Their area is not to scale on the map.
Entities drawn by more than one Natural Earth polygon: CYP, SOM (Cyprus includes Northern Cyprus; Somalia includes Somaliland). Their fills paint multiple paths.

16 Factbook files could not be joined to a registry entity and were skipped: australia-oceania/at.json (Ashmore and Cartier Islands), europe/ax.json (Akrotiri), central-america-n-caribbean/bq.json (Navassa Island), australia-oceania/cr.json (Coral Sea Islands), europe/dx.json (Dhekelia), middle-east/gz.json (Gaza, Gaza Strip), north-america/ip.json (Clipperton Island), europe/jn.json (Jan Mayen), east-n-southeast-asia/pf.json (Paracel Islands), east-n-southeast-asia/pg.json (Spratly Islands), australia-oceania/um.json (Baker Island, Howland Island, Jarvis Island, Johnston Atoll, Kingman Reef, Midway Islands, Palmyra Atoll), australia-oceania/wq.json (Wake Island)...
8 entities have no Factbook entry; their People, Government and industry sections render as not published: ALA, BES, GLP, GUF, MTQ, MYT, REU, UMI

Biome shares fall outside 1.0% of 100 for 114 entities. 78 are small territories under 50,000 km2 that RESOLVE Ecoregions does not resolve (verified: a 4x finer simplification tolerance did not improve them). 36 are larger countries whose polygons include substantial inland water or ice that carries no terrestrial ecoregion -- Tanzania's great lakes, Canada's Great Lakes, the Greenland ice sheet. Shares are reported as computed and never rescaled to 100.

5 entities' measured polygon area differs from their published land area by more than 25% (ESH -66%, ALA -52%, PYF -38%, MAR +30%, FRO -25%). These are boundary-definition differences, not measurement errors. Most significant: Natural Earth draws the de facto administered boundary in Western Sahara at both the 110m map and 50m biome resolutions, which agree with each other. Both give Western Sahara roughly a third of its internationally recognised extent (about 96,000 of 266,000 sq km), with the remainder drawn inside Morocco. Area and biome figures for both entities should be read with that in mind.
15 entities have no biome data, mostly small island territories absent from the 50m geometry.

WPP/OWID cross-check: 4 of 1180 comparisons differ materially (TGO). Our figures match the UN WPP source file exactly, so these reflect Our World in Data substituting a different source for those entities, not a defect in our pipeline. See crosscheck_owid.json.
